name: Indefatigable Traveler
body:
Indefatigable Traveler (Ex)
Source Mythic Origins pg. 24
You can run and charge while fatigued or exhausted, and you ignore the movement penalty while exhausted. When traveling overland (see page 172 of the Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook), you can expend one use of mythic power to be able to hustle for a number of hours equal to your tier without taking nonlethal damage or becoming fatigued (this is in addition to the 1 hour per day normally allowed for hustling). In a day of normal walking, you can walk 8 hours plus 1 hour per tier before you must start making Constitution checks to avoid nonlethal damage.
